decisions.reason: The 15-day express option overlaps with the broader express line and lacks prominent placement, so its option value is low and the firm abandons it.
The 72-hour express program retains a distinct speed advantage and low holding costs, so the firm keeps the option open while demand uncertainty remains.
The multi-model express delivery line has its own page and covers multiple segments, so the firm keeps this valuable option to resolve remaining uncertainty.
The online platform is a strategic digital option with its own page and high option value, so the firm keeps it to capture future digital service demand.
The fire and smoke protection door is only mentioned and overlaps with existing fire-rated products, so its marginal value is low and the firm drops it.
